ValidationRule.description: Credit review needs a risk rating, a debt service coverage ratio, and a named approver.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Credit Review"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Conditionally Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closing"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Booked")), OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Risk_Rating__c)), ISBLANK(Debt_Service_Coverage_Ratio__c), ISBLANK(Credit_Approver__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter the Risk Rating, Debt Service Coverage Ratio, and Credit Approver before credit review.
